The memo CRUD mutations and queries reside in `/bench/repo/web/src/hooks/useMemoQueries.ts`.

Checking `useMemoQueries.ts` and `connect.ts` to identify the generated service client.

The answer is clear.

The frontend module is `/bench/repo/web/src/hooks/useMemoQueries.ts`. It uses the generated service client `memoServiceClient`, imported from `@/connect` (`/bench/repo/web/src/connect.ts`). The client is created via `createClient(MemoService, transport)`, where `MemoService` comes from `@/types/proto/api/v1/memo_service_pb`.
Checking for other modules that define memo CRUD hooks to confirm the primary location.

The memo CRUD mutations and queries reside in `web/src/hooks/useMemoQueries`.

It uses `memoServiceClient` from `@/connect`.

q17.
web/src/hooks/useMemoQueries.ts; memoServiceClient

The memo CRUD React Query hooks live in `web/src/hooks/useMemoQueries.ts`: `useMemos` / `useInfiniteMemos` (list), `useMemo` (read), `useCreateMemo`, `useUpdateMemo`, and `useDeleteMemo`. They all call `memoServiceClient`, imported from `@/connect` (`web/src/connect.ts`), which is a Connect RPC client created from the generated `MemoService` in `web/src/types/proto/api/v1/memo_service_pb.ts`.
